faqs.answer: Soft play prices in Hull typically range from £4-8 per child for a standard session. Many venues offer discounts for siblings, under 1s often go free, and off-peak sessions can be cheaper. Party packages start from around £10-15 per child.

faqs.answer: Yes, several soft play centres in Hull offer dedicated SEN sessions with reduced numbers, lower music/lighting, and additional support. Check individual venue pages for their SEN provision and session times.

faqs.answer: Most soft play centres in Hull offer birthday party packages including exclusive use of party rooms, food, and dedicated play time. Packages typically include invitations, party bags, and a host. Book early as weekends fill up quickly.
